name: Sync relay alias map
description: Rebuilds the hardened relay's DB-free routing map from the enabled domains/aliases and pushes it over the tunnel when it has changed. Runs every cron pass (every_run) as the reconcile floor behind push-on-change, so a newly created alias is valid on the relay before reject_unmatched can bounce mail to it. No-op on colocated deployments.

force.label: Force re-push even when unchanged (e.g. after a relay rebuild)
